title: RecordingHacks Microphone Profile
description: Data model for a single microphone (or microphone set) profile page scraped from recordinghacks.com/microphones. Shapes were derived empirically from all 1761 profile pages in the scrape; see AUDIT.md and audit_report.json for the evidence behind every field. Every parsed section also retains a raw form so no page content is lost when a value does not match an expected pattern.

permalink.description: Permalink printed in the page body. Present on 53% of pages.

scraped_file.description: Path of the saved HTML relative to the scrape root, e.g. 'ADK/Cremona-251-Au'.

brand_slug.description: URL path segment for the manufacturer, e.g. 'AKG-Acoustics'.

model_slug.description: URL path segment for the model, e.g. 'C-414-XLS'.

mic_id.description: Site-internal numeric mic id, recovered from image paths such as /images/mics/01705/. Useful as a stable primary key.

manufacturer_url.description: URL of the manufacturer's listing page on the site.

classification.description: How the site categorizes the product. 'subtitle' is the authoritative human label (81 distinct values across the corpus); the derived fields below are parsed from it and from the tag list.

subtitle.description: The <h2 class="sub"> descriptor, e.g. 'Multi-Pattern Tube Condenser Microphone', 'Stereo Mic Set'. Present on 100% of pages.

product_type.description: Discriminator. 'set' pages (105 of 1761) describe a bundle of other mics and use a different table layout: they carry `set` and omit most of `specifications`.

transducer_type.description: Derived from the subtitle and tags. The spec-table shape corroborates it: condensers carry a 'Capsule Dimensions' column (1128 pages), dynamics 'Coil Diameter' (286), ribbons 'Ribbon Construction' (159).

is_tube.description: True when the subtitle or tags mark a valve/tube circuit.

is_multipattern.description: True for switchable or continuously variable polar patterns.

pattern_icons.description: Polar-pattern icons shown beside the title. Includes summary markers such as '9 polar patterns' and 'continuously variable pattern selection' that are not single patterns.

tags.description: Site tag vocabulary; 393 distinct values observed, present on 94% of pages. Top values: condenser, side-address, large-diaphragm, transformerless, end-address, transformer-coupled, multipattern, dynamic, hpf, tube. Full frequency table in audit_report.json -> tags.

pricing.description: From the sidebar 'Pricing & Availability' list. Present on 100% of pages; only two list markers exist in the corpus: id='money' (MSRP, always present) and id='none' (Discontinued, 509 pages).

msrp_raw.description: Verbatim MSRP line, e.g. 'MSRP: $1,695' or 'MSRP: n/a'.

msrp_amount.description: Parsed numeric MSRP; null when the page says n/a.

currency.description: ISO-4217 code inferred from the symbol; 'USD' for '$'.

notes.description: Any other line in the pricing list, kept verbatim.

specifications.description: Parsed from the <table> blocks under the 'Specifications' heading. Columns are identified by their <th> label; 36 distinct labels exist. Absent sub-objects mean the page had no such column.

pickup_patterns.description: 'Pickup Patterns' column (1572 pages). Each entry is a pattern followed by '(<sensitivity> mV/Pa; <frequency response>)'. Multi-pattern mics list several.

pads.description: 'Pad: -10dB (Via Switch)' entries from the 'Pads & Filters' column (557 occurrences).

filters.description: 'Filter: ...' entries from the 'Pads & Filters' column (638 occurrences).

capsule.description: 'Capsule Dimensions' column (condenser mics, 1128 pages). 351 of those read only 'Diameter n/a'.

coil.description: 'Coil Diameter' column (dynamic mics, 286 pages). NOTE: this column reads 'n/a' on every page in the corpus, so the site never populates it. Modeled for completeness.

ribbon.description: 'Ribbon Construction' column (ribbon mics, 159 pages). Partly labeled (Length/Width/Gauge) and partly free prose such as '50x5mm, 2-micron aluminum ribbon'.

impedance.description: 'Impedance' column (1656 pages). Format '<n> Ohms (<category>)', e.g. '200 Ohms (Low)'.

spl_noise.description: 'SPL/Noise' column (1656 pages): 'Max SPL' (1189) and 'Self-noise' (866). 220 pages read only 'SPL n/a'.

max_spl_note.description: Qualifier such as a THD percentage stated alongside max SPL.

physical.description: 'Weight', 'Length' and 'Max Diameter' columns (1656 pages each). Each cell states metric first with the imperial equivalent in parentheses.

interfaces.description: 'Interface(s)' column (1656 pages). Format '<connector> (<count>)', e.g. '3-pin XLR male (1)' (1435 pages), 'USB (1)', 'Apple Lightning (iPhone 5) (1)'.

power.description: 'Power Specifications' column (1656 pages). A set of flag lines plus an optional labeled 'Phantom voltage' (807 pages).

phantom_voltage_v.description: One or more accepted phantom voltages, e.g. [48] or [12, 24, 48].

includes_tube_power_supply.description: True on 254 pages, effectively the tube-mic marker.

compatible_capsules.description: 'Compatible Capsules' column (84 pages, modular bodies with detachable capsules). Each entry names another product on the site and repeats its pattern and sensitivity.

raw_tables.description: Loss-free capture of every specification table exactly as published: the <th> labels and the aligned cell text. This is the guarantee that the model 'fits it all' — anything the typed fields above do not recognize is still recoverable here.

frequency_graphs.description: Per-pattern frequency-response charts, published as tables headed 'Frequency Response - <Pattern>'. 664 pages (38%) carry at least one, for 933 charts in total; a single table can hold several patterns, so multi-pattern mics have one entry per pattern.

pattern.description: Pattern the chart belongs to, including qualifiers such as 'Cardioid (Kick Drum mode)' or 'Bidirectional (Front of ribbon)'.

related_microphones.description: The 'Related Microphones' / 'Related Microphone Sets' tile strip, present on 1326 pages (75%). Each tile carries an editorial relationship note in its title attribute ('The SF-1 is the mono version of the SF-12.', 'The KM-69 was designed to reproduce the sound of the KM-84.'), which makes this the site's explicit product-lineage graph. NOTE: this section sits outside div#column, so a main-content-only extractor misses it entirely.

name.description: Display name from the tile caption, e.g. 'Royer Labs SF-12'.

relationship_note.description: Editorial note stating how the two products relate.

is_set.description: True when listed under a 'Microphone Sets' heading rather than 'Related Microphones'.

content.description: Editorial body copy. Present on 100% of pages.

description_html.description: Body prose as published, preserving inline links to related mics and capsules.

release_year.description: Parsed from sentences such as 'The mic was released in 2009.'

links.description: Every outbound and cross-reference link, grouped by the sidebar section it appeared under. The list-item id encodes the medium: www (3330), pdf (1831), forum (155), film (112), image (60).

documentation.description: From the '<Model> Documentation' section (1624 pages): manuals, spec sheets, frequency-response PDFs, product pages.

awards.description: From a '<Model> Awards' section (~150 pages), e.g. '2011 TEC Awards'.

related_products.description: In-body links to other mic profiles on the site — the basis for a 'variant of' / 'based on' graph.

other.description: Links from any section not matched above, kept so nothing is dropped.

primary_photo.description: Sidebar hero shot, present on 94% of pages.

images.description: All other images in the body: capsule photos, alternate views, diagrams.

capsule_links.description: Links into the site's capsule reference, e.g. /capsules/#CK12.

set.description: Only for product_type='set' (105 pages). These pages replace the specification tables with a bundle manifest.

included_accessories.description: Label/value table present on all 105 set pages.

included_microphones.description: Member mics, each cross-linked to its own profile page.

extraction.description: Extractor bookkeeping, so a record carries its own confidence signal.

unmapped_sections.description: Section headings the extractor did not recognize.

unmapped_columns.description: Specification <th> labels the extractor did not map to a typed field.

pattern.description: Pattern label as published, including any qualifier.

pattern_variant.description: Parenthetical qualifier, e.g. 'Kick Drum mode', 'Warm', 'tube circuit', 'Front of ribbon'.

has_graph.description: True when the cell carried a CHART marker linking to a frequency-response graph.

value_db.description: Attenuation in dB for a pad, e.g. -10.

frequency_hz.description: Corner frequency for a filter, e.g. 100.

mechanism.description: The <small> qualifier, e.g. 'Via Switch', 'Via Remote Control'.

dimension.description: A length published as metric with an imperial equivalent, e.g. "213mm (8.39'')".

mass.description: A weight published as metric with an imperial equivalent, e.g. '500g (17.64oz)'.

link_type.description: From the list-item id on the page; 'internal' for same-site cross references.
